violations.ruleName: Static class has public non-extension methods
violations.message: Static class has public non-extension methods: Lib.Calc
violations.description: Cohesion / dependency inversion: a public static class whose public methods are not extension methods is a hidden service — it couples every caller directly to the implementation with no seam for testing or substitution. Static utility behaviour that cannot be expressed as an extension method belongs behind an interface.
violations.recommendation: Preferred: extract the logic into an instance class, define an interface, and register it in DI (e.g. 'ISlugGenerator' / 'SlugGenerator'). If the method is a pure transform on its first argument, convert it to a true extension method by adding 'this' to that parameter. Internal static classes used only within the same assembly are exempt from this rule.

violations.message: Documented method has undocumented parameter: a
violations.description: Incomplete API contracts erode trust in documentation: a method that carries a <summary> but omits <param> tags for one or more parameters signals to callers that the docs cannot be relied upon. Partial documentation is often worse than none, because it creates a false sense of completeness.
